message: A load balancer (ALB, NLB or classic; ELB interface ...) uses this security group: revoking public access on port 80 (or all traffic) breaks the HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect or cuts the service. Alternative: leave only 443, or exclude the resource in Drata with the justification that the load balancer only redirects.
The key policy of the key must allow cloudtrail.amazonaws.com before applying; otherwise the trail stops logging. Apply the key first and then the trail.
An instance that uses this security group is not reachable through Systems Manager (CMP-006: not registered or agent offline): revoking SSH or RDP leaves it with no access. Enable SSM first.
IMDSv2 required: old SDKs or agents that only use IMDSv1 stop getting credentials.
The app or pipeline that uses that access key breaks when it is deactivated: rotate first, deactivate afterwards.
Clients that access the bucket over plain HTTP will fail.
Encrypting an existing resource requires a migration with downtime.
Removing VantaNonProd from a production resource brings it into Vanta's scope and may open new tests.
Replacing the key policy can leave the key inaccessible: keep the account root statement.
Multi-AZ has an additional cost and a brief failover during the change.
